author: Primal Space
description:
Did Kubrick film the fake moon landing?

Who knows! But he and his team were definitely a master of SFX, in a time where practical effects dominated. Using techniques like taping items to rotating glass in front of the camera, rewinding and re-recording film and using amazing combinations of light, color and camera positioning, they brought out-of-this-world effects for ‘2001: A Space Odyssey’ that blew minds in the 1960s.
title: How The Stanley Kubrick Filmed The Space Odyssey
